notes.title: Information on Save File Compatibility Issues
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088285/71ca15d4b47533ec1a1b86867975197cf6beb372.png[/img]

Nyan-Nyan Punch! Remake includes many additional elements and changes, so save files from the previous version are not compatible.

We recommend you to start a new game and overwrite the existing save file. The remake's save file displays the current saved map and difficulty level, while the original version's save file does not.

If you cannot proceed due to an error that occurred on the save screen, you can resolve the issue by directly removing the files as follows.


[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088285/ca8ca3b86de7762cf1789a08b86cdfed389dfb12.png[/img][/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088285/a3f6fd1a47983aefe12b706d96e75704ea3fac53.png[/img][/td]
[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088285/4b6d513cfdd1f57c3bd4dcd37f02709c99c411b8.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table] 
[olist][*] Click the gear button on the right side of the Steam library, then click [b]Manage[/b] and then [b]Browse local files[/b].
[*] Open the folder named [b]www[/b].
[*] Next, delete all files in the [b]save[/b] folder.[/olist]

We ask for your understanding on this issue.

notes.title: Nyan-Nyan Punch! Remake Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44088285/0906243c789d69d3fff07b83d97445913993f836.png[/img]

Nyan-Nyan Punch presents a new look through the remake update! Many changes and additions have been made, including:

[list][*] Improved graphics and cutscenes
[*] More diverse and character-fitting attack patterns 
[*] New stages: 'Kila' the killer whale, and 'Rafi' the chameleon
[*] Hidden bonus side story after the ending
[*] Variety of additional abilities and purchasable items for the player
[*] Various basic attacks to be used in addition to punch
[*] Miscellaneous QoL updates[/list]

This remake update is only available to users who have purchased the game. The pre-update build will be available as the "Original" version, and please note that save files are not compatible between these two versions.

Thank you to everyone who played the game, and we hope you enjoy the remake.
